board_fee_key_one.name: board_fee_key_one
board_fee_key_one.value:
("board_fee"."key_kind" = 'unit' AND "board_fee"."unit_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("board_fee"."qualification_option_id", "board_fee"."qualification_id", "board_fee"."subject_id") = 0)
      OR ("board_fee"."key_kind" = 'option' AND "board_fee"."qualification_option_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("board_fee"."unit_id", "board_fee"."qualification_id", "board_fee"."subject_id") = 0)
      OR ("board_fee"."key_kind" = 'qualification' AND "board_fee"."qualification_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("board_fee"."unit_id", "board_fee"."qualification_option_id", "board_fee"."subject_id") = 0)
      OR ("board_fee"."key_kind" = 'subject' AND "board_fee"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("board_fee"."unit_id", "board_fee"."qualification_option_id", "board_fee"."qualification_id") = 0)

board_fee_confirmed_whole.name: board_fee_confirmed_whole
board_fee_confirmed_whole.value: ("board_fee"."provisional" AND "board_fee"."confirmed_at" IS NULL) OR (NOT "board_fee"."provisional" AND "board_fee"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)

board_series_exams_ordered.name: board_series_exams_ordered
board_series_exams_ordered.value: "board_series"."exams_start" IS NULL OR "board_series"."exams_end" IS NULL OR "board_series"."exams_end" >= "board_series"."exams_start"

board_service_fee_confirmed_whole.name: board_service_fee_confirmed_whole
board_service_fee_confirmed_whole.value: ("board_service_fee"."provisional" AND "board_service_fee"."confirmed_at" IS NULL) OR (NOT "board_service_fee"."provisional" AND "board_service_fee"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)

charge_instalment_shape.name: charge_instalment_shape
charge_instalment_shape.value: ("charge"."kind" = 'instalment') = ("charge"."plan_exception_id" IS NOT NULL AND "charge"."instalment_no" IS NOT NULL AND "charge"."registration_id" IS NOT NULL)

charge_service_shape.name: charge_service_shape
charge_service_shape.value: "charge"."kind" NOT IN ('cash_in', 'late_cash_in', 'certificate_split') OR ("charge"."board_service_id" IS NOT NULL AND "charge"."board_series_id" IS NOT NULL)

courseEnrolment_one_open_idx.name: courseEnrolment_one_open_idx
courseEnrolment_one_open_idx.where: ended_on IS NULL AND unit_id IS NULL

courseEnrolment_one_open_unit_idx.name: courseEnrolment_one_open_unit_idx
courseEnrolment_one_open_unit_idx.where: ended_on IS NULL AND unit_id IS NOT NULL

exam_certificate_collected_whole.name: exam_certificate_collected_whole
exam_certificate_collected_whole.value: ("exam_certificate"."status" = 'collected') = ("exam_certificate"."collected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "exam_certificate"."collector_name" IS NOT NULL)

examEntry_one_live_charge_idx.name: examEntry_one_live_charge_idx
examEntry_one_live_charge_idx.where: status <> 'withdrawn' AND charge_id IS NOT NULL

examEntry_one_live_unit_idx.name: examEntry_one_live_unit_idx
examEntry_one_live_unit_idx.where: status <> 'withdrawn' AND unit_id IS NOT NULL

examEntry_one_live_award_idx.name: examEntry_one_live_award_idx
examEntry_one_live_award_idx.where: status <> 'withdrawn' AND qualification_id IS NOT NULL

exam_entry_kind_target.name: exam_entry_kind_target
exam_entry_kind_target.value: ("exam_entry"."kind" = 'unit' AND "exam_entry"."unit_id" IS NOT NULL AND "exam_entry"."qualification_id" IS NULL) OR ("exam_entry"."kind" = 'award' AND "exam_entry"."qualification_id" IS NOT NULL AND "exam_entry"."unit_id" IS NULL)

exam_entry_submitted_whole.name: exam_entry_submitted_whole
exam_entry_submitted_whole.value: "exam_entry"."status" NOT IN ('submitted', 'amended') OR "exam_entry"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL

payment_late_transfer_recorded_whole.name: payment_late_transfer_recorded_whole
payment_late_transfer_recorded_whole.value: ("payment"."late_transfer_at" IS NULL AND "payment"."late_transfer_amount" IS NULL) OR ("payment"."late_transfer_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment"."late_transfer_amount" > 0)

refundWindow_one_scope.name: refundWindow_one_scope
refundWindow_one_scope.value: ("refund_window"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "refund_window"."academic_year" IS NULL) OR ("refund_window"."session_id" IS NULL AND "refund_window"."academic_year" IS NOT NULL)

registration_to_verify_idx.name: registration_to_verify_idx
registration_to_verify_idx.where: prior_sitting_source IN ('declared_by_family', 'declared_by_desk') AND prior_sitting_verified_outcome IS NULL

registration_prior_sitting_outcome_valid.name: registration_prior_sitting_outcome_valid
registration_prior_sitting_outcome_valid.value: "registration"."prior_sitting_verified_outcome" IS NULL OR ("registration"."prior_sitting_verified_outcome" IN ('verified', 'rejected') AND "registration"."prior_sitting_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "registration"."prior_sitting_series_id" IS NOT NULL)

session_offer_item_enters_valid.name: session_offer_item_enters_valid
session_offer_item_enters_valid.value: ("session_offer_item"."enters_kind" = 'award' AND "session_offer_item"."qualification_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("session_offer_item"."enters_kind" = 'option' AND "session_offer_item"."qualification_option_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "session_offer_item"."enters_kind" IN ('units', 'subject')

session_offer_item_fee_key_one.name: session_offer_item_fee_key_one
session_offer_item_fee_key_one.value:
("session_offer_item_fee_key"."key_kind" = 'unit' AND "session_offer_item_fee_key"."unit_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("session_offer_item_fee_key"."qualification_option_id", "session_offer_item_fee_key"."qualification_id", "session_offer_item_fee_key"."subject_id") = 0)
      OR ("session_offer_item_fee_key"."key_kind" = 'option' AND "session_offer_item_fee_key"."qualification_option_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("session_offer_item_fee_key"."unit_id", "session_offer_item_fee_key"."qualification_id", "session_offer_item_fee_key"."subject_id") = 0)
      OR ("session_offer_item_fee_key"."key_kind" = 'qualification' AND "session_offer_item_fee_key"."qualification_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("session_offer_item_fee_key"."unit_id", "session_offer_item_fee_key"."qualification_option_id", "session_offer_item_fee_key"."subject_id") = 0)
      OR ("session_offer_item_fee_key"."key_kind" = 'subject' AND "session_offer_item_fee_key"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("session_offer_item_fee_key"."unit_id", "session_offer_item_fee_key"."qualification_option_id", "session_offer_item_fee_key"."qualification_id") = 0)
